mechanics.summary: Historical SQL identifies Hagara as entry 55689 and encounter 1296 on map 967. The current checkout has DATA_HAGARA_THE_STORMBINDER at index 3 but no Hagara AI, loader call, spawn/object mapping, or lifecycle code.
Main phase uses Focused Assault, Ice Lance, Shattered Ice, and later Ice Tomb; the first intermission is selected by weapon glow and later Ice/Lightning intermissions alternate.
Five-second physical channel on the current target, 50% normal weapon damage every 0.5 seconds, five-yard range; reported unblockable, undodgeable, and unparryable.

Unattackable edge crystals fixate a player near Hagara and fire a beam/missile; the impact is three-yard Frost damage. Icy Veins reports two casts per main phase, three crystals, one missile per second for 15 seconds. Heroic vulnerability is disputed.

Random players are entombed/stunned until the tombs are destroyed; tombs do not splash, break line of sight, and are absent from the first main phase. Guide and Encounter Journal counts conflict in 25H.
Random-player Frost blast with four-second movement reduction; the spell page reports 92,500–107,500 damage and a 1.4-second cast, but the target cone/random rule and mode tuning are not frozen.
Frozen Tempest protects Hagara from all attacks and creates four Frozen Binding Crystals; all four must die to end the Ice intermission.

Four equidistant cardinal waves sweep clockwise across the platform; contact is lethal in strategy prose. Reference rows report 190,000–210,000 Frost in three yards and +50% Frost damage taken for 2.5 seconds.
Players inside Hagara's bubble lose a percentage of maximum health and are slowed; current table/guide rows report 12%, while one heroic strategy paragraph reports 12.5%.
Random outer-edge impacts are reported to deal high Frost damage and knock back players within seven yards.
Heroic-only random-player stacking snare; reported 10% slow plus 10% each second for 15 seconds, 25% maximum-health expiry damage, and a ten-yard Frostflake Snare field with 50% slow.
After all four Ice crystals or all Lightning conductors are completed, Feedback stuns Hagara and increases damage taken by 100% for 15 seconds.

Lightning intermission raid damage is reported as constant/random ticking Nature damage, with each tick adding 5% Nature damage taken; exact current encounter spell linkage differs from the generic spell page.

A Bound Lightning Elemental starts the chain; its death charges a nearby Crystal Conductor, then Lightning Conduit connects nearest targets/conductors within ten yards until all conductors overload. Conductor counts conflict by source.
Heroic guidance reports Storm Pillars appearing around the room and exploding after three seconds for 35,000 damage.

unresolved.detail: The requested build/locale/cutoff is metadata only; no matching DBC or hotfix export was audited.
The global raid unlock is the cutoff; no exact-boundary live sample proves launch tuning, and later modifier identity/persistence remains unresolved.
The later official announcement names the aura and Lord Devrestrasz but supplies no aura/NPC IDs or persistence semantics.
Retail Power of the Aspects is historical and cannot substitute for Classic Presence.
Current health observations have unspecified modifier state and no complete four-mode coefficient table.
Current code has the data slot but no Hagara AI, loader call, spawn/object mapping, phases, reset, or credit path.
Entries 57462, 57955, and 57956 cannot be mapped confidently to the four current modes.
Five-second/0.5-second/five-yard reports exist, but heroic follow/cancel behavior, target filter, and cooldown are not frozen.
Guide cadence and spell-family IDs exist, but build-matched missile linkage, target exclusions, and crystal count are not proven.
Sources report 25% per hit versus 10% per stack; no fixed coefficient is promoted.
Normal attack-speed reduction target, duration, stacking, and reset are not frozen.
25H is reported as five and six; cadence and first-main exclusion runtime are not validated.
Reference damage/cast values conflict with unspecified mode state and old front-arc comments.
Sources report approximately 30 seconds for the first main and 50 seconds generically.
Weapon selection is reported, but transition grace and exact later scheduler are absent.
Immunity is qualitatively confirmed; exact current spell linkage and removal state are not.
Historical entry 56136 and four-crystal rule exist, but health, positions, and completion event are not current executable evidence.
Four cardinal clockwise waves and reference damage are reported; cadence, movement, and lethal collision behavior are not frozen.
12% and 12.5% reports conflict; tick interval and bubble radius are absent.
Seven-yard knockback and random outer-edge impacts are reported without a current damage/area-trigger table.
Guide and spell values exist, but expiry/dispelling, snare identity, radius, and reset behavior are not build-matched.
Spell effect is 100%/15 seconds and triggers are reported, but phase resume timing and event linkage are not implemented.
5% Nature stack is reported, while the generic spell page is a different six-second scripted spell and supplies no encounter tick damage.
Guide, Encounter Journal, and Icy Veins disagree on mode count and layout.
Entry 56700 is historical; count, health, death trigger, target, and reset are not implemented locally.
20,000 Nature per second and ten-yard nearest link are reported, but tie-break, bounce, overload order, and completion timing are unknown.
Three-second/35,000 damage is a guide observation; count, target, radius, spell identity, and raid-size scaling are absent.
Alternation is qualitative; eight-minute enrage is a community comment without spell identity or runtime interaction proof.
No current Hagara AI supplies cleanup for crystals, waves, conductors, elemental, auras, or area triggers.
Historical access/loot and guide achievement text exist, but current Classic prerequisite, lockout, completion, loot, achievement, and player-credit behavior are not validated.
